sources.title: XinnanZhang/Qwen3-8B-openthoughts3-math-400k-sft · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: The cause is in the training data, not the recipe: only 29.4%of the SFT targets actually close </think>and emit a \boxed{}answer. The remaining 70.6% hit a ~16k generation cap mid-reasoning, after which the chat template still appends <|im_end|>— so the model is trained to emit EOS in the middle of a thought.
